story.title: Story 3: Turn Construction and Recovery Cascade

result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial Story 3 verification against the story ACs/TCs, tech-design DD-4/DD-7, test-plan Flow 3, production turn compose/derive/recovery paths, logging surface, work-queue live-work semantics, and Story 3 tests. Configured story and epic gates passed, but a focused recovery race probe failed and required TC coverage is missing.

newFindings.title: Recovery write-back can clobber a worker's ready result
newFindings.evidence: TC-3.8d requires a live worker to win after floor rendering. In packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/recovery.ts:67-83, recoverDerivation updates any row matching subject/type/source_version after the live-work check; it does not guard against the row already being ready. A focused probe seeded a ready row with content "real result", called recoverDerivation with "floor result", and failed with: "expected ready worker content to survive, got floor result". This models the race where a claimed worker completes and deletes its work_item just before recovery opens its transaction. The Story 3 test at packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts:255-293 only proves a queued live item remains untouched; it never completes the worker and asserts the real ready result survives.

newFindings.title: Required cascade TC scenarios are not covered in story tests
newFindings.evidence: The story/test-plan map TC-3.2c, TC-3.4a, and TC-3.5a to packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts. That file currently has six tests at lines 82, 107, 140, 172, 224, and 255, covering ready use, pending floor, failed floor, re-derive, tool truncation, and queued live-work deferral. rg found no test evidence for TC-3.2c, TC-3.4a, TC-3.5a, floor-unavailable/original fallback, runtime-change placement during turn construction, or multiple not-ready derivations producing a no-hole turn.

productionPathFindings: SV-03-001: production recoverDerivation can overwrite a ready derivation after the live work item has completed and been deleted.
No fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or production mock path was found in the Story 3 turn construction path; provider doubles are confined to tests.
additionalObservations: Configured gates passed with 45 test files passing and 9 real-inference tests skipped because LHC_OPENROUTER_KEY is unset; the skipped real-inference tests were not used as Story 3 evidence.
